Poi.label: Établissements (POI)
Poi.schema: CREATE TABLE poi_public (id BIGINT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), type VARCHAR(50), lat DECIMAL(10,8), lon DECIMAL(11,8), addr_street VARCHAR(255), addr_housenumber VARCHAR(20), addr_postcode VARCHAR(10), addr_city VARCHAR(100), status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'published', is_closed TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, closed_at DATETIME, closed_reason TEXT, claimed_by BIGINT, claimed_at DATETIME, status_claim VARCHAR(20))

PoiReport.label: Signalements de POI
PoiReport.schema: CREATE TABLE poi_reports (id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, poi_id BIGINT, user_id BIGINT, report_type VARCHAR(20), reason TEXT, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pending', reviewed_by BIGINT, reviewed_at DATETIME, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

PoiContribution.label: Contributions de POI
PoiContribution.schema: CREATE TABLE poi_contributions (id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, poi_id BIGINT, user_id BIGINT, contribution_type VARCHAR(20), fields_modified TEXT, fields_count INT, contribution_score INT, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'auto_approved', reviewed_by BIGINT, reviewed_at DATETIME, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

CommuneGeometry.label: Géométrie des communes (centroids)
CommuneGeometry.schema: CREATE TABLE commune_geometry (name VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY, centroid_lat DECIMAL(10,8), centroid_lon DECIMAL(11,8), bounding_radius_km DECIMAL(8,4))
